exposure: timing of breech presentation during pregnancy (after 30.0 weeks gestation, 30.0-36.6 weeks, and 37.0-birth)
duration of breech presentation during pregnancy (5-8 weeks, 9-12 weeks)
cohort: The study included 191 children aged 3 years or younger with developmental dysplasia of the hip (cases) and 209 healthy controls.
finding: Breech presentation after 37.0 weeks gestation was associated with a more than threefold higher risk of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), with the risk increasing with the duration of breech presentation.
followup_time: Up to 3 years after birth (age of children at outcome assessment)
gest_age: Exposure measured after 30.0 weeks gestation, with specific periods analyzed: 30.0-36.6 weeks and 37.0-birth for term children.
